meaning:
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.39; married to Mehetabel (H4105); also called Hadar at Gen.36.39;
Another name of ha.dad (הֲדַד "Hadad" H1908H)
§ Hadar = "honour"
an Edomite king
